title: Pixelmon Controlify Bridge
description: Adds controller-friendly keybinds so Controlify can trigger Pixelmon actions.
body:
Pixelmon Controlify Bridge is a small client-side NeoForge compatibility mod that lets Controlify trigger Pixelmon actions reliably from a controller.

Pixelmon keybinds can appear in Controlify, but binding those native actions directly may not trigger the expected Pixelmon behavior from a controller. This mod adds a separate set of bridge keybinds that Controlify can bind normally. When one of those bridge keybinds is pressed, the mod calls the matching Pixelmon action directly.

## Features

- Send out / recall a Pixelmon party member
- Select the next or previous party member
- Trigger the Pixelmon party action
- Use and cycle external moves
- Open Pixelmon screens such as Pokedex, summary, Research, Day Care, Trainer Card, and Wiki
- Trigger Pixelmon's battle spectate action

## How to use

Install this mod alongside Pixelmon and Controlify on a NeoForge Minecraft 1.21.1 client.

Then open the controls screen and bind the entries under the Pixelmon Controlify Bridge category. Use those bridge entries instead of binding Pixelmon's native keybinds directly through Controlify.

## Compatibility

Version 1.0.0 is tested with:

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.234
- Pixelmon 9.3.16
- Controlify 3.0.0+lts

## Notes

This is a client-side compatibility mod. It does not include or redistribute Pixelmon or Controlify.

This is an unofficial compatibility project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Pixelmon or Controlify.
